desc:
💥 Ragdoll Rampage 💥

Smash, launch and blast crash test dummies in a giant physics playground! 🤸

🔫 40+ weapons: bats, katanas, rocket launchers, flamethrowers, classic rifles and a real Black Hole device
🔧 Gunsmith: build your own guns with optics, lasers, grips and stocks
💉 Syringes, superpowers and Flight. Turn dummies into chaos machines or soar over the map!

🚨 Scenarios: rob a house, pull off bank and museum heists, rescue subway hostages and more
🩺 Doctor Mode: check every bone you break
🍳 Cook dummies (and explosive barrels 💣) in the giant microwave

🌀 Grab and fling dummies with your hands or the Gravity Gun
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime bonuses, daily quests and a free reward for joining Huaj Studios!
👥 Play with friends in multiplayer

Earn eliminations, unlock every weapon and cause total chaos! 👑
